entry.title: Discovery Is Infrastructure: Why Agents Need Open Signals Before Platforms
entry.summary: As agentic systems mature, I keep getting pulled into the same discussion: Should we build an “agent exchange”? A marketplace. It’s a reasonable instinct. Platforms are tangible, fundable, and easy to explain. But if we look at how the internet itself scaled, a different pattern emerges; one that is worth revisiting before we hard-code the future of agent ecosystems. The most durable digital ecosystems have not been built on centralized exchanges. They have been built on open discovery standards, which then enabled many kinds of platforms to emerge naturally on top. That distinction matters. entry.title: I Built a Lead Qualification System in 7 Days Using n8n + AI
entry.summary:
I just shipped an automated lead qualification system for a B2B SaaS client. The whole build took 7 days from kickoff to production deployment. The sales team was manually reviewing 50+ demo requests per week. About half were unqualified (students, competitors, tire-kickers). They needed automation that could: Enrich leads with company data Score based on ICP fit
Route qualified leads to sales, others to nurture campaigns n8n for workflow orchestration Clearbit for company enrichment Custom scoring logic (revenue, employee count, tech stack) HubSpot for CRM integration 70% of leads auto-qualified (no human touch needed) Sales team saves 15 hours/week 2x faster response time to hot leads $0 in ongoing costs (self-hosted n8n) Don't try to score leads with just email and name. Enrich first with: Company size Revenue estimates
Tech stack Funding status Started with complex ML scoring. Scrapped it. Went with simple if/then rules: Company size > 50 employees? +10 points Uses Salesforce? +5 points Has funding? +5 points Edge cases will break your automation. Build in a "needs review" queue for: Scores between 40-60 (gray area) Missing enrichment data VIP domains (investors, partners) I wrote a detailed walkthrough with code snippets and n8n workflow screenshots here: Lead Qualification System Breakdown Happy to answer questions about the build, n8n workflows, or automation architecture in general!
